title: Refunds, VIP waivers & credit (Udhaar)
summary: Every privileged money override is request → locked subject → approver → mandatory cash-back prompt.
markdown:
# Refunds, VIP waivers & credit

All three follow the **approval-ping pattern**: the front desk requests, the subject is frozen
(`approval_lock`), an approver with the right permission decides in `/approvals`, and any cash owed
to the patient appears as a **mandatory cash-back prompt** at the counter.

## Refund (patient-initiated, §1.6)

1. `POST /opd-tickets/{id}/refund-request {"reason_code": "DoctorUnavailable", "note": "doctor called away"}`
   → `ticket.approval_lock = "RefundPending"`; the patient disappears from the doctor's screen.
2. Approver (`approval.refund.approve`; after clinical activity `approval.refund_elevated.approve`, see below):
   `POST /approvals/{request_id}/approve`. The ticket becomes `Refunded` and **clinically locked**:
   any clinical write answers `CLINICAL_LOCKOUT` — *"Patient ticket has been refunded. Cannot add clinical
   data without an active billing slip."* (show verbatim).
3. Counter: `ticket.cash_back_prompts[]` (also event `refund.ready`) → hand over the cash →
   `POST /opd-tickets/{id}/refund/confirm-dispensation`. Cash leaves the counter's open shift.

If the visit already has clinical activity (a note or prescription), the request is marked
**CLINICAL ACTIVITY EXISTS**, needs the *elevated* approver (owner) and is flagged for risk review;
prefer the post-consultation VIP waiver below in that case.

## Post-consultation VIP waiver (§1.7)

Patient already examined, owner/doctor decides not to charge:
`POST /opd-tickets/{id}/vip-waiver-post-consult {"reason"}` → approval (`approval.waiver.approve`) →
ticket `payment_status: "Waivered"` (NOT Refunded — waived visits are excluded from fraud sweeps)
→ `waiver.refund_order.ready` → counter hands back the cash →
`POST /opd-tickets/{id}/waiver-refund/confirm-dispensation`.

## Pre-consultation VIP waiver (§1.8)

Unpaid slip (`payment` omitted at registration) → `POST /opd-tickets/{id}/vip-waiver-request
{"reason", "waiver_pct": 100}` → on approval the ticket is queued free (the ledger books gross revenue
and a discount/waiver contra entry).

## Credit / Udhaar (§1.9)

`POST /opd-tickets/{id}/credit-request {"amount_paid_now": 400, "reason": "short of cash"}` (with
`Idempotency-Key`). The paid-now part is collected immediately; on approval
(`approval.credit.approve`) the rest becomes a receivable, the ticket is `CreditAuthorized` and queued.
From then on `GET /patients/search` shows the **OUTSTANDING BALANCE** banner and new slips are blocked
until settled (`POST /finance/ar/{ar_id}/settle`) — except Emergency.

## Approver screens

`GET /approvals` (queue for my permissions, elevated first; `mine=true`: my own requests),
`GET /approvals/{request_id}` to open one, `approve` / `reject` (note required) / requester `cancel`. Nobody
approves their own request (`SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN`), except the Owner of a one-person clinic (below). Every request in these answers says what you may do with it:
show Approve and Reject only when `can_decide` is true; `decide_blocked` says why not (`own_request`,
`missing_permission`, `decided`), so the queue never has to fail a decision to find out. The decision takes no
co-signer: a large cash drop is simply never approved by the cashier of its shift (`DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON`). A request opens only for its requester and the holders of
its `required_permission` (the people the queue and its notifications show it to); anyone else gets `FORBIDDEN`.
Offer the link only to them: an `approval_request_id` shown on another screen (a ward indent) is no reason to open it.

## A one-person clinic (solo practice)

The approver is never the requester. One exception: with the Owner's `solo_practice_mode` on (a control setting) and
nobody else able to approve, the Owner approves their own refund, waiver or credit request with a note (the request
says so in advance: `self_decision` is `allowed_with_note`, otherwise `forbidden`; `solo_practice_mode` is also in
`GET /meta/settings`):
`POST /approvals/{request_id}/approve {"note": "..."}`. Without the note: `VALIDATION_ERROR`. In any other case
`SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN`, whose `details` say why (`solo_practice_mode`, `owner`, `other_approvers`). The approval
then shows `solo_self_approved: true`; each one is a risk item (`SOLO_SELF_APPROVAL`), and the Owner hears the month's
count on the first of the next month.
